label: Google HTML5 / DOOH creative spec — DOCUMENTED STUB, OUT OF SCOPE IN v1
description: Google's HTML5 creative requirements for Display & Video 360 / Campaign Manager (Google Ads HTML5 upload) are a different delivery format from this skill's MP4 output. Documented here so the shape is known; not implemented and deliberately out of scope for v1.

intended.deliverable: ZIP of HTML5 assets (index.html + assets), not MP4
constraints: hard file-size cap on the ZIP (Google: 150 KB for HTML5 upload in most placements)
no external network requests; all assets inlined or bundled
click-through tag (ExitApi) required for clickable creatives
polite loading: initial load under ~2 s on a mid-range Android device
intended.whyOutOfScope: The size cap is incompatible with the current image strategy (full-resolution PNG cutouts + inlined fonts + inlined GSAP). A compliant build needs a separate asset pipeline: WebP/AVIF at placement size, subset fonts, and a minified GSAP subset. That is a different product surface from an in-store signage loop.

blockers: asset budget: inlined base64 fonts alone are ~100 KB before any image
requires a second encoder target (WebP/AVIF) and a size-budget checker
requires the ExitApi integration for clickable creatives
